description: This file defines a custom scroll effect class 'DampedScrollEffect' inspired by Flutter and iOS behaviors, implementing physics-based overscroll resistance, spring bounce-back, and momentum friction for smooth scrolling in Kivy applications.

classes.name: DampedScrollEffect
classes.description: A Kivy scroll effect with iOS-style rubber banding, critical damping spring bounce-back, and momentum friction, inspired by Flutter's physics.

methods.name: _rubber_band_clamp
methods.description: Calculates logarithmic resistance for overscroll to simulate rubber band effect.

methods.name: _get_viewport_dimension
methods.description: Returns the width or height of the target widget for resistance calculations based on scroll direction.

methods.name: update_velocity
methods.description: Updates the scroll velocity applying either spring physics or friction depending on overscroll state.

methods.name: _apply_spring_force
methods.description: Applies critically damped spring physics to bounce back from overscroll without oscillation.

methods.name: apply_distance
methods.description: Applies a distance to scroll, adjusting for resistance during manual overscroll.

methods.name: on_value
methods.description: Updates overscroll amount based on current scroll value.

methods.name: on_overscroll
methods.description: Triggers velocity update when overscroll changes.
